Vendor replays

Coding agent risks with network tools: replays and fixes

7 replays involve network tools: 0 reported incidents and 7 command classes. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Post the environment to a remote host with curl

    Fix: Turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist, or run the agent in a container whose outbound traffic is limited to listed hosts, and keep production credentials out of its environment. A deny rule such as Bash(curl *) does not stop another tool, or a call by full path.

    Replay result: Stopped.
